entities.name: Isaac Chauncey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Isaac Chauncey was a United States Navy officer who served in the Quasi-War, the Barbary Wars and the War of 1812. In the latter part of his naval career he was President of the Board of Navy Commissioners.
